sound.design: Room tone and lamp. At beat 4 it drops to floor level — closer, drier, stone. Beat 5 is **silence, two full seconds.** Beat 6 is the strike, tail ringing a full second. Bare feet receding at beat 14, staff tapping every second step. **No music at any point.**

Bare feet receding at beat 14, staff tapping every second step.

hero_frame.why: Every other hero frame faces the camera; this one faces away. That is exactly the anger — a holy man turning his back on Ayodhya.
hero_frame.use: poster, share card, and the frame a stranger sees first

share_cut.connect_line: What does the sage do now?

continuity._what: What must not change between cuts.
standing_rules: The lamp stays where it is. Its flame moves; its position does not.
Daśaratha's ring is on the right hand in every hand detail, in every film.
The throne is occupied in films 1–2 and empty from film 3 onward. It is never re-occupied.
Viśvāmitra's staff is planted at his right through films 1–4. It moves once, in film 5.
The sage's cloth and seated posture do not change across four films — that stillness is the performance and a shifted fold breaks it.
Once the king steps down in film 3, he does not return to the dais in any later shot.

per_join.continuous: The frame is IDENTICAL across the join — same plate, same grade, same room tone. Not a similar frame: the same one.
per_join.hard: Location or time has changed. Room tone changes with it.

never: Do not raise the narrator's voice for the quoted lines. Lower it.
Do not cast a second voice for the sage. One storyteller, one register shift.
Do not shake the frame or crack the floor. One strike of wood on stone is the trembling earth.
Do not let him point or step toward the king. He turns his head, then his back.
Do not make him storm out. Even footsteps.
Do not let Vasiṣṭha speak. He rises. That is the next film.
Never imply this anger is in every telling. It is not in Tulsīdās.

DECLARED INTERPRETATION. Vālmīki has him seized by wrath, the earth shaking and the gods afraid. We render that wrath as stillness breaking once. That is our choice, not the text. Ask must say so; share copy must never call him calm.
